gen-dafont-joystix-gf-cossette-texte: Generous lowercase with a wide-eyed e and a prominent x-height gives the text an uncluttered face. Cossette Texte would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye, while Joystix keeps its widely tracked arcade lettering up top.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hind-siliguri: Joystix spaces its arcade lettering out wide, with stems only slightly heavier than the arms that join them. Joystix grabs attention, Hind Siliguri holds a steady line of text.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-khula: Arcade swagger comes from Joystix, with its widely tracked lettering. Joystix does its best work as a display voice, whereas Khula, tall in the midsection with curves held open, is built for text.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-lexend: Joystix lays down arcade lettering, widely tracked, with just a hint of stroke variation in every glyph. Joystix is the showpiece; Lexend, with its oversized lowercase, does the steady reading.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-mada: Joystix brings arcade swagger: widely tracked lettering, plus a compact gap up to the ascender line. Mada keeps its curves open and its midzone towering, so the loud heading never crowds the text.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-michroma: Joystix tracks its arcade lettering out wide. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth and leaves daylight in its curves, so its tall-bodied lowercase makes paragraphs feel spacious.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-nobile: Joystix goes loud and arcade, its widely tracked lettering showing only a restrained shift in stroke weight. Nobile sits below with open letter mouths and little gap between lowercase and caps, giving the heading quiet company.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Joystix has a widely tracked, arcade look, its line steady yet faintly modulated. Noto Sans Avestan takes the text, with open curve tips and a pronounced x-height, while Joystix does its best big and short.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Joystix spaces its arcade lettering wide apart. What stands out is the pull between the arcade punch of Joystix and the big open counters in each small letter of Noto Sans Bamum.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-batak: Joystix brings widely tracked arcade lettering with sturdy strokes. Noto Sans Batak, with a towering x-height and an e that never squeezes shut, handles the text, while Joystix is at home big and short.
